# dsh-sidebar-panel-fold
English | 中文
A DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin that keeps **only the global panels you choose** in the left sideba
r and folds every other panel into its **More** menu — so the workspace and session list get the ver
other panel into its **More** menu — so the workspace and session list get the vertical space back.
Every plugin that adds a `sidebar.panellist` entry (Automation tasks, Task Board, Skill Center, SSH,
Context Insights, Agents, and so on) would otherwise get its own launcher row. This plugin turns th
at fixed list into a preference:

- **设置 → 侧边栏面板** (Settings → Sidebar panels) shows one switch per registered panel.
- Switch on → th

e panel keeps its launcher row in the sidebar.
- Switch off → the launcher row is hidden, and the pa

nel appears in the sidebar's **More** menu instead; clicking it opens the panel as usual.
- **Plugin
s** always keeps its launcher — it is the shell's own entry.
Defaults when no preference is stored yet: **Context Insights** and **Agents** stay, everything else
s when no preference is stored yet: **Context Insights** and **Agents** stay, everything else folds.
## Requirements
- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.2-rc.1** or newer (the sidebar More menu and the settings section seats thi

s plugin builds on).
- The Web GUI (`dsh web` / desktop app). The bundle has no Host capability of i
ts own and no third-party dependencies.
## Install
The bundle is installed from this checkout with the plugin manager; it is enabled on install and aff
ects every session in the profile.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Or, in the app: **Plugins → Add plugin**, pick this directory, then enable it. Uninstall from the sa
me page, or `plugin_manager remove_bundle @lisongjianustc/dsh-sidebar-panel-fold`. Removing the plug
in removes every fold rule and the settings page; nothing else is touched.
## Usage

1. Open **Settings** (sidebar foot → account menu → Settings) → **Sidebar panels**.
2. Flip the swit

ches. Each row reads either **Shown in the sidebar** or **Folded into More**.
3. **Restore defaults*
* puts the shipped default back.
The sidebar updates immediately, the More menu lists whatever is folded, and the choice survives app
restarts, Web GUI port changes and browser-profile changes.
## Where the preference lives
`$DSH_HOME/plugin-state/sidebar-panel-fold/visible-panels.json` (default `~/.dsh/plugin-state/sideba
r-panel-fold/visible-panels.json`):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`visible` lists the panel ids whose launcher stays in the sidebar; every other registered panel is f
olded. A panel that is not installed costs nothing — unknown ids are simply ignored. Delete the file
to fall back to the defaults.
## How it works
The plugin uses only public extension points of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar`:
1. **`sidebar.panellist`** — every global panel registers its icon and label here. The plugin reads
the registrations (id, order, label) and injects one stylesheet rule that hides the launcher row of
each folded panel, matched by the row's accessible name (the same label the shell projects). Rules a
re recomputed when panels register, when a panel label changes, and on a language switch; folding no

thing writes no rules.
2. **`sidebar.panellist.actions`** — the rows of the sidebar's More menu. The
plugin registers one row set that lists the folded panels; `onOpen(id)` opens the panel, `onDismiss

()` closes the menu.
3. **`settings.section` + `settings.section.icon`** — the Settings page and its

u.
3. **`settings.section` + `settings.section.icon`** — the Settings page and its navigation glyph.
The Host half reads and writes the preference file and serves it to the page over one same-origin pr
efix route (`/sidebar-panel-fold/api/state`, GET/POST JSON). It imports only Node builtins, register
s no tools, and holds no session state.
Deliberately avoided: replacing another plugin's panel registration, rewriting CSS-module hashes, re
ading another plugin's DOM for layout, and importing Harness UI primitives (the two surfaces a plugi
n may reach without a compiled build are the slot registry and the host route).
## Limits
- Folding is a launcher-row preference: the panel itself, its main-panel registration, its keyboard
shortcuts and the current selection are untouched. A folded panel can always be opened from **More**

.
- If a future Harness version changes the sidebar's `nav`/`aria-label` structure, the fold rules s
imply stop matching — the rows come back and nothing else breaks. Re-check this plugin after a Harne

ss update.
- The preference is per user, not per profile or per workspace.
## Development
Plain JavaScript, no build step:

- `index.js` — Host half: preference file plus the state route.
- `client.js` — browser half: fold r

ules, More-menu rows, settings page.
- `locale/*.json` — panel display metadata (title/description)

per locale.
- `cordis.patch.yml` — the bundle row (`sidebar-panel-fold`).
After editing the Host half, restart the bundle (disable → enable in the plugin manager) so the new
module is imported; after editing the browser half, reload the page.
